title: City Council District 3
statement: San Antonio is not a corridor I walk away from when the sentiment turns south. The pulse shows that neighborhood trailing the city's mood — sentiment at -0.04 versus a citywide 0.045 — and the crime index right at the city line. That gap is small right now, but it's exactly where neglect starts. I stand with San Antonio the same way I stood with the complaint response last cycle: this community filed a grievance, and I answered it with an operational response, not a promise. The dispatch breakdown for Fruitvale and the placement confirmation for D3 youth are on the way. Corridors don't decay because people stop caring — they decay because City Hall stops looking. I'm still looking.

payload.text: D3 dispatch breakdown and placement confirmation filed: Fruitvale dispatch volume consistent with city averages; D3 youth placements confirmed in the apprenticeship pipeline. San Antonio complaint logged as active, response plan targeted this cycle.
